description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Repeat.
